deliverable: Fix only assigned concrete CI diagnostics and size violations while preserving behavior and assertions. Report files read/modified/created, decisions, acceptance symbols and unresolved out-of-scope requests, then stop.
acceptance: Same Root-owned complete remote RV1 suite, unchanged public contracts and all selected assertions; only static self-review in worker.
